svg.title: HyperWeave — monolith
svg.desc: One solid cherenkov ink. Thickened frame (window at 0.90), core in the same ink. The Vercel move: silhouette does all the work.

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: Total chromatic commitment: the mark IS the hue.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: Single fill #0A45D6 across frame and core; the gem window carries all contrast as negative space. Window scaled 0.90 so the frame holds weight at 16px.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: No highlight, no depth, no second color — recognition rests entirely on the silhouette, which is exactly the bet Vercel and Framer won. Weakest variant for expressing the liquid brand world; strongest for never falling apart anywhere.
hw:reasoning.hw:spatial-notes: 64x64, bilateral about (32,32); cushion cardinals +/-29; core anchored at center. Static and filter-free by set doctrine: identity first, motion is a layer added after selection.
